description: Works out the figures of the open DIYA-GL book (one business's sales, purchases and bank lines for a year): the profit and loss account, the balance sheet, the tax and VAT figures and the compliance checks, each figure with the label the spreadsheet prints for it, and the book checks. Use this when the person asks what their profit, turnover, tax bill or VAT due is, or which lines make up a figure (entryNumbers). It does not change the book, file anything or contact HMRC.

entryNumbers.description: true gives every figure the entryNumbers of the lines behind it; a list of figure keys (for example section/profit-loss-account/sales-turnover) gives them to those figures only

name: report
title: Report a DIYA-GL book's figures
